propositions: Tolerant Pydantic parsing can normalize structurally divergent provider/model responses to semantically empty results that are incorrectly treated as valid verification outcomes

Semantically empty verifications (raw-empty or malformed-to-empty) are correctly rejected downstream via pass3_decide's no-verification rule that routes them to indeterminate, but telemetry buckets (clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable) are implemented only in verify_findings kernel function and not yet wired into live plan_review_decide and code_review_decide pipelines

Recoverable non-empty responses from supported provider/model variations must remain normalized and accepted while semantically empty results are explicitly classified as indeterminate or contract-failure outcomes
The verify_findings kernel function with outcome_counts telemetry is shipped and unit-tested, but pipeline-level wiring into production step-functions requires follow-up work tracked separately
